description: Point the lesson viewer at this session's transcript ($PPID is Claude Code, so other sessions are ignored), and send questions to the viewer instead of the terminal.

hooks.command: echo 'AskUserQuestion is disabled in learn sessions: its questions cannot be shown or answered in the lesson viewer. Ask the same thing with the learn ask tool (one question per call), or with quiz if it has a right answer.' >&2; exit 2
